description: This source file contains extension methods for configuring TLS security options and features for Orleans connections, including methods for TLS setup on connection builders and classes/interfaces related to TLS certificate handling, handshake, and connection features.

classes.name: TlsClientAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Contains settings for client-side TLS authentication configuration, including protocols, certificates, and callback functions.

classes.name: TlsOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates general TLS options, including certificate validation, protocols, timeouts, and callback handlers.

classes.name: TlsServerAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Holds server-side TLS configuration, such as server certificate, protocols, and certificate requirements.

methods.name: UseClientTls
methods.description: Extension method to configure a connection builder to use TLS as a client with specific options.

methods.name: UseServerTls
methods.description: Extension method to configure a connection builder to use TLS as a server with specific options.

methods.name: LoadFromStoreCert
methods.description: Loads an X509 certificate from the specified certificate store based on subject, store name, location, and validation flags.

methods.name: AllowAnyRemoteCertificate
methods.description: Sets the TLS options to accept any remote certificate (disabling strict validation).
